title: Yellow Crunchy Italian Hazelnut Fritters
description: Crispy Italian fritters filled with hazelnuts and fermented to perfection, dairy-free friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, cornstarch, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Add lemon zest, olive oil, and non-dairy milk to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a warm place to ferment for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Preheat the agemono-deep-fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Once the oil is hot, drop the fermented dough by tablespoonfuls into the oil, making sure not to overcrowd the fryer.
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle the fritters with hazelnuts and serve warm.
